extraction.Name: John Scissons
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 1, 1920, by the Bonesteel State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Royal Union Mutual Life Insurance of DeMoines for $5000; deeded to Mule Head Ranch & Cattle Co. for $1.00 subject to the mortgage of $5000, assumed by the purchaser
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739678 issued; East half of southeast quarter section 16, township 97, range 69; Lots 6 and 7 section 15, Lot 2 of section 22; receipt for the patent was signed April 3, 1920, by the allottee; on March 1, 1921, John Scissons deeded the land to Mule Head Ranch & Cattle Co.
